reviews.title: BoB Addiction Is Real!
reviews.text: I’ve been playing this game for years now and it’s seriously the best escape. The community of people have become like family and many complain about having to pay to play but that’s just not true. Play to win? Absolutely. I mean you have to understand that some people have put thousands and thousands in to the game so of course they have the best stuff and are farther ahead than people who don’t but you CAN grow with little to no money involved...especially if you’re in the right alliance and active. Most likely you’ll end up putting some money in to it if you play for any amount of time though. It’s a great escape from the real world and very fun...especially during any fighting events. Big rivalries which make the events 100x better and a big enough game to have many kingdoms and a wide diversity of players but small enough that you begin to know most of the top players in every kingdom after awhile. I quit for a few months when I had personal things come up in life but friends took care of my account and now I’m back and feel like I never left.

reviews.title: Random reassignment isn’t random!
reviews.text: I am a student of game strategy & probability and I must say that the latest reorganization of kingdoms for Grand Palace seems very suspect! How does a “random reassignment” result in all super kingdoms assigned to 1 quadrant? The probability of this happening by pure chance is almost impossible. I was looking forward to a reshuffling but it appears the deck was stacked against my kingdom. This makes for a very poor gaming experience!
